title: When Meaning Stays the Same, but Models Drift: Evaluating Quality of Service under Token-Level Behavioral Instability in LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the technical stability and 'Quality-of-Service' (QoS) of LLMs under prompt variation. It proposes a diagnostic framework called PBSS to measure semantic drift, but it does not evaluate or benchmark components related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
